The reference list identifies that original as “Student and teacher outcomes of the class-wide function-related intervention team (CW-FIT) program” (Exceptional Children, 2016; DOI printed). The sole supplied shipped row, index 730, is Kamps et al. (2015), “Class-Wide Function-Related Intervention Teams “CW-FIT” Efficacy Trial Outcomes,” a distinct earlier efficacy trial, so it does not represent the cited 2016 original. The supplied prior adjudication path was absent; no objection text was available to review.
